title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ). As λ increases, the penalty on large coefficients increases, which can affect the model's variance.

title: Effect of Lambda on Variance
text: When λ is increased in ridge regression, the model's flexibility is reduced. This means the model becomes less sensitive to the fluctuations in the training data, which typically results in a decrease in variance.

title: True or False: Variance Tends to Zero
text: Consider the effect of increasing λ on the model's variance. Does the variance tend to zero as λ increases?
